gloss: returning to school; resuming one's studies

definitions.gloss: returning to school; resuming one's studies
definitions.explanation: Going back to school or university after a period of absence, such as a leave of absence, illness, or suspension.

examples.japanese: {来学期|らいがっき}{復学|ふくがく}する{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: I plan to return to school next semester.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}が{治|なお}ったので{復学|ふくがく}した。
examples.english: I returned to school after recovering from my illness.

examples.japanese: {休学|きゅうがく}{期間|きかん}が{終|お}わったら、{復学|ふくがく}{届|とどけ}を{出|だ}す{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: When the leave of absence ends, you need to submit a return-to-school notification.

notes:
Used in academic and administrative contexts for students who return to their studies after a formal absence.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {復学|ふくがく}{届|とどけ}: notification of return to school
- {復学|ふくがく}{手続|てつづ}き: procedures for returning to school
- {復学|ふくがく}を{許可|きょか}する: to permit return to school
- {復学|ふくがく}{後|ご}: after returning to school

RELATED WORDS:
- {休学|きゅうがく}: leave of absence (from school) — the opposite action
- {退学|たいがく}: dropping out, withdrawal
- {編入|へんにゅう}: transfer (to another school)
- {復職|ふくしょく}: returning to work — the workplace equivalent

FORMS:
{復|ふく} (return, restore) + {学|がく} (study, school). Parallel to {復職|ふくしょく} (returning to work) and {復帰|ふっき} (returning/comeback).
